Blake3Nova in hot-proofs-blake3-circom.Short Description of the Vulnerability: The Blake3Nova circuit's depth checking mechanism uses circomlib's LessThan and GreaterEqThan templates without validating input bit lengths. When inputs exceed the expected range, the comparison can yield incorrect results, allowing bypass of depth verification.
Blake3Nova in hot-proofs-blake3-circom.Short Description of the Exploit: An attacker can provide a depth value that exceeds expected bit length, causing the comparison to incorrectly evaluate and bypass the depth check.
Blake3Nova in hot-proofs-blake3-circom.Proposed Mitigation: Add explicit bit length validation using Num2Bits to ensure all inputs (depth, leaf_depth) remain within expected ranges before comparison operations.
